Market today: The mood is shaky, driven by broad tech weakness. Chip shipments are strong, but that's not enough to offset the general tech sell-off impacting your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SMCI (-44.99%), SOXL (-78.17%), and MU (-61.79%) are deep in the red and all marked 'SELL'. Given your margin use, these drawdowns are amplified and need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on QQQ and SPY. Their continued weakness signals broader market trouble that will hit your tech-heavy portfolio hard.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech and leveraged ETF holdings are under severe pressure; focus on risk management.
plays: Trim SOXL: It's down nearly 80%. Consider cutting losses further.
Trim SMCI: Down almost 45%. Re-evaluate your conviction here.
Consider trimming MU: Down over 60%. This leveraged ETF is a major drag.
